name: pdf-to-word-converter
description: Arabic-first PDF to Word converter: React + Ant Design + Tailwind frontend, Node.js backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.desktop: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
